en: A message shows Not sent, how do I retry?

steps: Press Try again on the failed message
edgeCases: Non-retryable Meta codes: 131026 not on WhatsApp/blocked, 131047 window, 131049 frequency cap, 131051 unsupported type, 132001 template missing, 2494051 no payment method on Meta account
Retryable codes retried automatically by the queue
gaps: The UI does not translate Meta error codes into Arabic reasons per message (help docs list a few)
